name: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Claw your way from underpaid code-monkey to a six-figure-a-day tech deity, then choose whether to remain a brilliant recluse or seize the corner office and everyone's soul along with it.

branches.name: Machine Learning Engineer
branches.description: The grueling climb from debugging other people's code at 2am to being one of the most sought-after minds in AI.

levels.title: Junior ML Engineer
levels.description: You barely got hired despite years of self-taught skill, and now you're fixing production bugs no one else wants to touch.
levels.promotion_message: You've landed the job. Barely. Hope you like long nights and short paychecks.

levels.title: ML Engineer
levels.description: You've stopped being the intern who gets yelled at, but the hours are still brutal.
levels.promotion_message: You've earned a real title. The grind continues, but now you get a badge that says 'ML Engineer' instead of 'Intern.'

levels.title: Senior ML Engineer
levels.description: Your models finally work more often than they crash, and management has noticed.
levels.promotion_message: Senior title, senior stress. But at least people ask your opinion in meetings now.

levels.title: Lead ML Engineer
levels.description: You lead a small team of engineers who are just as exhausted as you used to be.
levels.promotion_message: You're a lead now. Weekends are yours again, mostly, sometimes, occasionally.

levels.title: Staff ML Engineer
levels.description: Your work now influences products used by millions, and the company finally pays you like it.
levels.promotion_message: Staff Engineer. The grind is finally starting to pay off, literally. From here, your path forks.

branches.name: AI Visionary Track
branches.description: Retreat from the corporate circus and become the reclusive genius whose algorithms quietly run the world.

levels.title: Principal ML Engineer
levels.description: You now solve problems the rest of the company doesn't even understand yet.
levels.promotion_message: Principal Engineer. Your code is basically scripture to the junior devs now.

levels.title: Distinguished Engineer
levels.description: Conferences fight over your keynote slot, and your inbox is full of job offers you ignore.
levels.promotion_message: Distinguished Engineer. You could retire on your reputation alone, but the math is too fun to quit.

levels.title: Chief AI Scientist
levels.description: You publish the papers everyone else builds their entire careers on top of.
levels.promotion_message: Chief AI Scientist. You work fewer hours than the interns and understand a thousand times more.

levels.title: AI Visionary
levels.description: Governments and megacorps alike quietly ask for your blessing before shipping anything.
levels.promotion_message: AI Visionary. Two days a week, and the world still bends around your models.

levels.title: Singularity Architect
levels.description: One day a week, two quiet hours, and you casually reshape the future of intelligence itself.
levels.promotion_message: You are the Singularity Architect. Take all the time off you want; the machines basically run themselves now, and so do you.

branches.name: Corporate Ascension
branches.description: Trade the lab coat for a boardroom and climb toward the top by any means necessary.

levels.title: Junior Executive
levels.description: You've traded algorithms for office politics, and you're surprisingly good at both.
levels.promotion_message: Junior Executive. You smile a lot more now, even when you don't mean it.

levels.title: VP of Strategic Exploitation
levels.description: You've learned to call layoffs 'synergy optimization' with a completely straight face.
levels.promotion_message: VP of Strategic Exploitation. Somewhere, an intern just lost their job because of a decision you made before lunch.

levels.title: Chief Operating Overlord
levels.description: Your name is on patents you didn't write and decisions you barely remember making.
levels.promotion_message: Chief Operating Overlord. Fewer meetings, more empires quietly crumbling under your signature.

levels.title: President of Global Domination
levels.description: Entire markets shift when you casually mention a product idea at dinner.
levels.promotion_message: President of Global Domination. Three days a week, and half the planet's economy answers to you.

levels.title: CEO
levels.description: Three short days a week, unlimited vacation, and an empire built on other people's brilliant, underpaid work.
levels.promotion_message: You are the CEO. Take all the time off you want, the empire runs on everyone else's exhaustion now, not yours.

author: CareerForge
